subject.title: fix: reject availability alert signups for unknown products

question: Should the unknown-product availability-alert fix preserve pending requests for products removed after signup, as this PR documents, or should the later current-dev PR mark those rows as notified in the cron?
rationale: Both open PRs address the same issue but encode different business behavior for products that disappear after signup, and automation should not choose that BL policy without owner intent.

options.title: Preserve pending-after-removal policy
options.body: Retarget this signup-time guard onto dev, preserve Zod validation, and avoid cron cleanup unless the BL owner reverses the documented decision.

options.title: Adopt cron cleanup path
options.body: Use https://github.com/Hamelyn-SL/hamelyn-serverless/pull/7198 as the canonical PR if the owner accepts losing pending alerts for products removed from the catalog.

options.title: Hold both until owner confirmation
options.body: Pause both PRs until the BL owner confirms whether deleted-product pending rows should survive or be terminally closed.

recommendation.title: Preserve pending-after-removal policy
recommendation.body: Retarget this signup-time guard onto dev, preserve Zod validation, and avoid cron cleanup unless the BL owner reverses the documented decision.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the requested reviewer on this PR and have the clearest current-main history on the notify route.
